data.name: label16.Text
data.value: After 18 trials, you need to follow the instructions on the display to start the actual study. There will be 45 test cases. Finally, we will provide you a questionnaire to share your experience with us.

data.name: label17.Text
data.value:
Now, Could you please put headphone on and place your non-dominant palm within the green line on the box.
Please click on "Start Training" When you are ready!

data.name: label18.Text
data.value:
You have now completed training
The actual test begins
Each test case will display for 5 seconds.
Each test will ask the same questions as trial stimulation.
Please click on 'Start Testing' to move to the next stimulation if you are ready.
